pages.title: Three Hands Healing — EFT, energy healing & bodywork with Maria · Texas
pages.description: Three Hands Healing — EFT, energy healing, bodywork, Qi Gong and Family Constellations with Maria. Online or in person in Texas.
h1: Feel good in your body, at peace in your mind, aligned in your life.

findings.title: no second indexable copy of the site on another address
findings.message: handprotocol.org/threehandshealing/ is a second, indexable copy of this site (canonical: https://handprotocol.org/threehandshealing/)
findings.fix: Point its canonical at https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/, or 301 it here.

findings.title: a visitor can reach the business
findings.message: there is no way to contact or book: no phone link, email link, form or booking link anywhere on the site (the "Book a session" button only scrolls the page)
findings.fix: Get one real contact route from the owner (a booking link, a phone number, or an email) and wire the main button to it.

findings.title: the copy does not say the page is unfinished
findings.message: the page tells visitors it is not finished: "n · Sessions in Texas Booking and contact details will be added at launch getting healthier and happier Three Hands Heal"
findings.fix: Get the missing detail from the owner (booking link, phone, prices) and replace the line.

findings.title: robots.txt names the sitemap
findings.message: robots.txt has no "Sitemap:" line
findings.fix: Add "Sitemap: https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/sitemap.xml". It is how Bing and other crawlers find the sitemap without a webmaster account.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: delete public/robots.txt so the engine serves /robots.txt itself, with the Sitemap line on the right host.

findings.title: the phone number is on the page and tappable
findings.message: no phone number on the site
findings.fix: Ask the owner whether they take calls or texts. If yes, add the number as a tel: link; if no, leave it out on purpose.

findings.title: the page says where the business works
findings.message: the page names no city: nothing tells a search engine (or a visitor) where the business works
findings.fix: Ask the owner for the city or service area, then put it in the title, the copy and the structured data. Do not guess it.

findings.title: the title fits in a search result
findings.message: the title is 71 characters; results cut off near 60 ("Three Hands Healing — EFT, energy healing & bodywork with Maria · Texas")
findings.fix: Lead with the service and the place; keep it near 60 characters.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: edit it in /admin/ → Search & sharing → Page title.

findings.title: the share image loads and has the right shape
findings.message: og:image is 1066×1600 (portrait): preview cards crop to about 1.91:1, so faces and words get cut
findings.fix: Serve a 1200×630 crop.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: the current engine builds a 1200×630 JPEG from the Featured photo; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the share image loads and has the right shape
findings.message: og:image is a WEBP file: several apps that build link previews do not show it
findings.fix: Use JPEG or PNG for the share image.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: fixed by the current engine (JPEG share image); run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: neither "address" nor "areaServed". Google lists address as required for local business results; a service-area business should state at least its city/region and areaServed
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: "telephone" is missing
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the page works at phone width
findings.message: 3 link(s) or button(s) are smaller than 44px on a phone
findings.fix: Give tap targets at least 44×44px.

findings.title: the page works at phone width
findings.message: 12 text block(s) render under 12px on a phone
findings.fix: Keep body text at 16px.

findings.title: AI search crawlers are not shut out by accident
findings.message: no AI-crawler rules in robots.txt: every crawler is allowed by the default group

findings.title: sitemap dates are present and plausible
findings.message: the sitemap has no <lastmod> dates. Google uses lastmod when it is accurate; changefreq and priority are ignored
findings.fix: Emit the real last-edit date per URL.

findings.title: /index.html is not a second copy of the home page
findings.message: https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/index.html answers 200 (the canonical tag points at https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/)
findings.fix: 301 it to the folder URL so there is one address.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: the current engine already redirects /index.html; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the site connects to the business's profiles
findings.message: no link to a Google Business Profile or a review page
findings.fix: Once the Business Profile is verified, link to it (and to its "leave a review" link) from the site.

findings.title: baseline security headers are present
findings.message: missing response header(s): Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add them at the host (netlify.toml [[headers]]). Not a ranking factor; it is basic hygiene.

findings.title: the link preview is complete
findings.message: link-preview polish missing: og:image:width/height (lets the first share render without a delay)
findings.fix: Add them.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: all emitted by the current engine; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: add a stable "@id" (for example https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/#business) so other nodes can point at the business
findings.fix: Correct the structured data.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: no opening hours (openingHoursSpecification). Add them once the owner confirms hours; by-appointment businesses can skip this
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: no "priceRange"
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness: no "sameAs" links (Business Profile, Instagram, Facebook). Add them once the profiles exist
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the home page names the site for search results
findings.message: no WebSite node: Google picks the site name shown above results from WebSite.name on the home page, then og:site_name, then the title
findings.fix: Add { "@type": "WebSite", "name": "<business name>", "url": "<home page>" } to the home page's JSON-LD.
